title: Hall numerical-method investigation (A9.36), Phase 1 diagnosis
label: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_NOT_SCORE_BEARING; PARAMETRIC / NOT_VALIDATED

a7_bridge.note: the Phase 1 runs used this version (recorded per run); the committed version adds a7_record (production observables) after it and changes nothing a7_run computes

diagnostic_driver.note: the resume rule was widened to all shard files of the output directory during Phase 1 (a re-ordered queue); the per-run record carries the driver sha256 it ran under

bridge_check.result: OK: window statistics on synthetic series; a7_run at v1 numerics reproduces bridge_lib.run_case bit for bit on two frozen A6 L0 cases (1.5356609867396142 mN / 0.13512827979427777 A; 22.737815552616503 mN / 2.3899979291901494 A = the frozen A6 L0 values)

tooling.environment: Julia 1.11.7, HallThruster.jl v0.23.1 bfb3019f (check_pin), threads / BLAS 1, nice; 3 worker processes on a 4-core host shared with other lanes

raw_outputs.location: outside the repository (session scratch); per-frame series are too large to commit

diagnostic_set.cases: the 22 A6 study cases (14 seeded + 8 mandatory A3 failures, incl. the 209 % case and the status flips; 7 of them fail at every A6 level)
diagnostic_set.runs: non-failing cases at L0, L1, L2 (2^k x v1 cells, dt 5 ns / 2^k) with 4 x the v1 duration and num_save 4000; failing cases at L0 (base, escape hatch disabled, CFL 0.2, 10 x initial plasma density) and L1 (10 x initial density); CFL 0.4 at L1 on 7 cases; reconstruction off and Crank-Nicolson energy at L1 on 2 cases; the 209 % case at L3 for 4 x duration; HallThruster.jl SPT-100 tutorial regression case at 160 / 320 / 640 cells and 1 / 2 / 4 x 2 ms
diagnostic_set.statistics: per run, over three windows (v1: second half of the v1 duration; A7: 1 x to 4 x the v1 duration; second half of 4 x): time-mean of the per-frame instantaneous thrust and I_d, batch-means SE (10 batches), half-window means, integrated-autocorrelation SE, RMS / mean, dominant frequency; and the thrust of the time-averaged state (the v1 / A6 statistic)

H-OSC.verdict: CONFIRMED (primary cause of the A3 / A6 thrust failures)
evidence_for: the v1 / A6 thrust observable is the thrust of the time-averaged state, m <nu>^2 / <n> at the exit (bridge_lib run_case: thrust(time_average(sol)))); by Cauchy-Schwarz it is <= the time-mean of the instantaneous thrust <m nu^2 / n>, and on oscillating runs (Id_rms_rel >= 0.1) it is 0.48-1.00 of it, case- and resolution-dependent (oscillating_statistic_comparison)

the A6 G(0) 39 % thrust failure (AMINDHMAX-LH8603|BZ-P5B16|BP-HI|VD-350|MF-HI|sgb-screen-09): time-mean thrust 48.97 / 51.05 / 50.62 mN at L0 / L1 / L2 (4 x duration), against the A6 statistic 24.55 / 34.13 / 34.85 mN

HallThruster.jl's own regression test (test/regression/regression_utils.jl at the pin) compares the steady mean of the per-frame thrust(sol) with tolerance std / sqrt(n), not the thrust of the averaged state

the v1 window (second half of the v1 duration, ~1.3-2 ms) holds only 1-30 periods; low-frequency modes (0.5-1.5 kHz) give 1-2 periods; same-numerics D(k) comparisons (duration doubled) differ by up to 14 % in A6 and the A7-window batch SE of such runs is 3-6 %
over a 3 x v1 window the time-mean statistic of oscillating cases agrees across L0 / L1 / L2 within its combined statistical uncertainty (grid_convergence_a7_window)
evidence_against: quiet runs (Id_rms_rel < 0.02) are unaffected: the two thrust statistics coincide to < 0.01 %

H-STEP.verdict: REFUTED as a cause (time step converged; the escape hatch is not involved)
evidence_against: the adaptive step is CFL-limited (pinned SimParams adaptive = true, CFL 0.799, dt = min(0.799 dt_iz, sqrt(CFL) dt_E, CFL dz/u)); halving CFL to 0.4 at L1 changes quiet runs by <= 0.01 % and oscillating runs by 0.3-1.7 %, inside their 2-sigma statistical allowance (jobs B-*)
with the escape hatch disabled (min_dt 1e-14 s, max_small_steps 1e9) the persistent failures are bit-identical to the base runs: the step never reached min_dt before failure
num_save only sets the sampling of the saved frames; the A6 L-ladder differences are spatial (they track the cell size, not dt)

H-SCHEME.verdict: CONTRIBUTING (sets the slow spatial convergence; not a defect)
evidence_for: the pinned discretization is formally first order where it matters: electron energy by upwind differences with backward-Euler (implicit_energy = 1.0), heavy species Rusanov fluxes with van Leer-limited (harmonic) MUSCL reconstruction that drops to first order at extrema, SSPRK22 time integration

quiet H1 cases converge monotonically at observed order 0.63-0.69 (thrust and I_d): L0 -> L1 1.3-2.6 %, L1 -> L2 0.8-1.75 %; L0 (the v1 / A6 production level) cannot meet a 2 % level-to-level criterion, L1 against L2 does
evidence_against: the order is consistent and monotone (no erratic grid dependence on quiet cases); the scheme options are the package defaults verified by its own MMS order tests
H-SCHEME.scheme_variants: reconstruction off and Crank-Nicolson energy at L1 on one oscillating and one quiet case (jobs C-*; results in the run table where completed)

H-FAIL.verdict: IDENTIFIED: discharge collapse (non-ignition / extinction) at high B_peak and low flow, followed by an explicit heavy-species NaN
evidence_for: every persistent failure first collapses: I_d falls from ~0.05-1 A to 1e-5-1e-2 A within microseconds, min n_e drops to 1e9-1e12 m^-3 and max T_e runs to 25-165 eV; the heavy-species update then returns NaN / Inf in the ion density across many cells (HallThruster.jl solution.jl failure path); failure times 0.1-3 ms
v1 XE: BP-HI x MF-LO fails in 100 % of cases (all geometries, shapes, V_d, transports); BP-LO x MF-HI / MF-MID in 0 %

the escape hatch is not involved (bit-identical with it disabled); CFL 0.2 lets some collapsed runs survive as extinct discharges (I_d ~ 1e-16-1e-5 A) or as strongly oscillating states, i.e. survival of the collapse is step-dependent while the collapse is not
a 10 x higher initial plasma density (DefaultInitialization min / max ion density) does not ignite a sustained discharge (all still collapse)

the A6 status flips are the same mechanism: LH12|BZ-P5B30|BP-LO|VD-350|MF-LO|sgb-02 is an extinct discharge (I_d 9e-16 A, PASS under v1 at L0) that fails at L1-L3; LH12|BZ-P5B16|BP-HI|VD-180|MF-HI|sgb-01 fails late (15 ms at L1) or, at L2, survives with a non-stationary negative mean thrust
NaN in the failure warning is located in the bulk (many cells), not at a boundary cell
evidence_against: a genuine physical non-sustainment at these operating points cannot be separated from a start-up / robustness limitation of the solver: the extinct state is reached from the package default initial condition only

H-TRANSPORT.verdict: NOT a candidate-specific cause; contributes through the model domain
evidence_for: the nine sgb-screen candidates are extrapolated from the P5 identification domain (P5-like channel, 230-274 V, 5 mg/s) to H1 at 0.377-3.2 mg/s and 69.9-268.6 G peak; the failing and strongly oscillating corners (BP-HI, MF-LO) lie furthest from it
evidence_against: v1 XE failure fraction is flat across the nine candidates (0.34-0.44) while it varies 0.12 -> 0.66 with B_peak and 0.19 -> 0.69 with flow (v1_axis_rates)
the ScaledGaussianBohm profile is analytic in z (evaluated at cell centres, identical at every level); its narrowest width (0.1 L) spans >= 13 v1 cells, so the profile is resolved at every level

evidence_for: HallThruster.jl's SPT-100 tutorial regression case (test/regression/spt100_tutorial.json at the pin: SPT-100, 300 V, 5 mg/s Xe, TwoZoneBohm(1/160, 1/16)) at the same bridge ladder (160 / 320 / 640 cells = 0.5 / 0.25 / 0.125 mm, dt 5 ns / 2^k): quiet (Id_rms_rel <= 0.012); A6 rule G(0) 0.57 % / 0.87 %, G(1) 0.44 % / 0.47 %, D(k) <= 0.01 %: passes the A6 criteria already at L0; A7 statistic identical conclusions
evidence_against: its observed order (0.57 % -> 0.44 %) is similarly low; the benchmark is simply far inside 2 %

H-MODE (found during Phase 1).verdict: RESOLUTION-DEPENDENT ATTRACTOR on one mandatory case (the A6 209 % case)
H-MODE (found during Phase 1).evidence: AMINDHMAX-LH8603|BZ-P5B30|BP-HI|VD-350|MF-HI|sgb-screen-08: L0 (4 x duration) an oscillating, non-stationary state (time-mean 28.4 mN, half-window drift 12 %, I_d 2.39 A); L1 and L2 a quiet state (70.28 / 70.94 mN, I_d 3.075 / 3.080 A, 0.9 % apart); A6 L3 (1 x duration) oscillating at 38.0 mN. The 4 x-duration L3 run is reported in the run table when complete. Such a case is converged only if its status, quiet class and values agree between the A7 production and check levels; nothing else is claimed

solver_numerical.evidence: H-OSC (observable = thrust of the time-averaged state; windows of 1-30 periods), H-SCHEME (first-order-limited spatial convergence: v1 / A6 L0 too coarse for 2 %), H-FAIL (explicit heavy-species update returns NaN after a discharge collapse). Time step: converged (H-STEP). Same numerics converge on the vendor benchmark (H-BENCH).

transport_coefficient_model_domain.evidence: failure and oscillation rates flat across sgb-screen-01..09; the collapse / breathing corners are furthest from the P5 identification domain; the credible transport set stays EMPTY (unchanged).

boundary_condition.evidence: failures originate in the bulk after a global collapse, not at a boundary cell; the vendor benchmark with the same boundary conditions converges; no boundary-condition variant was run (boundary conditions are physics, not numerics, under A9.36).

magnetic_field_input.finding: CONTRIBUTING through the operating regime (relevant to L-H1-BZ)
magnetic_field_input.evidence: B_peak at the high end of the H1F-BZ-03 band with the P5 surrogate shape gives 66 % failures and 96 % oscillating runs (BP-LO 12 % / 43 %); BZ-P5B30 fails more than BZ-P5B16 (46 % vs 33 %). On the DBF-1 hardware (G-RP1, BZ-P5B16): BP-HI x MF-LO 27 / 27 failures, BP-LO x MF-HI 27 / 27 quiet. The surrogate shape (P5 anode-to-peak ratio and gradient) is not an H1 field: an FE-derived H1 B(z) can move the regime boundaries; this does not make the numerics converge or fail by itself.

operating_point.finding: YES - with B_peak, the flow sets the regime
operating_point.evidence: MF-LO 69 % failures (MF-HI 19 %); BP-HI x MF-LO 100 %; low-flow quiet cases converge slowest (largest relative discretization error).

genuine_physical_non_closure.evidence: extinction at BP-HI x MF-LO from the default initial condition is not separable from a solver start-up / robustness limitation; under the SOURCED_SURROGATE B(z) a non-closure is never eligible (prereg asymmetric rule). These points remain unknowns.

rp1_dbf1_regime_map_v1_records.note: v1 XE records on G-RP1 (numerics v1; counts only)

identified_causes: C1 (observable): the v1 / A6 thrust is the thrust of the time-averaged state, a biased and phase-sensitive statistic on oscillating discharges; replace by time-means of the per-frame instantaneous thrust and I_d (the vendor regression convention).

C2 (window): the v1 window is too short for the oscillation periods present; use a longer window after a stated transient with a batch-means standard error, and treat statistically unresolved or non-stationary runs as unknowns.

C3 (spatial order): the first-order-limited scheme converges at order ~0.65; L0 (0.5 mm) is outside 2 %, L1 (0.25 mm) against L2 (0.125 mm) is inside for every quiet case seen; production must be L1 with an L2 check.

C4 (collapse): high-B_peak / low-flow operating points collapse to an extinct discharge and then fail numerically; these are unknowns (EXTINCT / NUMERICAL_FAILURE), never feasible and never an evaluated non-closure.
consequence: A7 registers a numerical method built on C1-C4 (prereg_addendum_a7_hall_numerical_method_v1.json) and demonstrates it first on the RP-1 subset (A9.38), on cases and a fresh seed it was not selected on.
